dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: All the previous targets have been handled. There aren't any new bounties right now, so you'll just have to wait a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: That said, it wouldn't be such a bad thing if there were never any new bounties again. Bounties exist to keep criminals in check, and if that's already working, all the better.
